tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Existence of a CMC sweep-out in almost hyperbolic cusps] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0240 ↗ def:chow-iv-hypersurface-sweep-out 1. ch33:33.11\group CMC and harmonic parametrizations

Given $[a,b]\subset \mathbb R$ and $\varepsilon _0>0$, every smooth metric on $[a,b]\times \mathcal V$ sufficiently close in $C^{2,\alpha }$ to $dr^2+e^{-2r}g_{\mathrm{flat}}$ admits a smooth family of CMC hypersurfaces which sweeps out $(a+\varepsilon _0,b-\varepsilon _0)\times \mathcal V$ and is $C^{2,\alpha }$-close to the standard slices.
